hebrewText: וַ/יְצַו֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת שָׂרֵ֥י ה/מיאות הַ/מֵּא֣וֹת פְּקֻדֵ֣י הַ/חַ֗יִל וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ הוֹצִ֤יאוּ אֹתָ/הּ֙ אֶל מִ/בֵּ֣ית לַ/שְּׂדֵרֹ֔ת וְ/הַ/בָּ֥א אַחֲרֶ֖י/הָ הָמֵ֣ת בֶּ/חָ֑רֶב כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן אַל תּוּמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה

tokens.bdb: (intensively) to constitute, enjoin
tokens.kjv: appoint, (for-) bid, (give a) charge, (give a, give in, send with) command(-er, -ment), send a messenger, put, (set) in order.

tokens.bdb: Jehojada, the name of three Israelites
tokens.kjv: Jehoiada. Compare H3111 (יוֹיָדָע).

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: a head person (of any rank or class)
tokens.kjv: captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord,(-task-)master, prince(-ipal), ruler, steward.

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
